problems.title: Tree Node Count
problems.description: Return the number of nodes in a binary tree encoded in level order. Trees use level-order notation with `null` for an absent child when needed. Node values are integers unless an expression or serialization task states otherwise.
problems.input_format: The input is a whitespace-separated level-order record; the examples show optional parameters and null markers.
problems.output_format: Print the requested value or traversal using single spaces, pipes, or commas exactly as described.
problems.constraints: 1 <= number of nodes <= 100000; -1000000000 <= node value <= 1000000000; referenced values exist when required.
hints: Choose BFS for level-based views and DFS for path, height, and subtree properties.
For BST tasks, use the ordering invariant to prune entire subtrees.
